posts.title: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
posts.summary: OpenAI's latest funding round reportedly isn't living up to expectations, with the company lowering its target.

posts.title: OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite
posts.summary: OpenAI raised only about $11 billion of a $30 billion target as big investors pull back from AI.

posts.title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
posts.summary: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard publishers can use to opt out of AI scraping and training.

posts.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
posts.summary: OpenAI says it will honor a shared robots.txt signal so website operators can state their AI training preferences to participating providers.

posts.title: Google, Anthropic and others to support new AI crawling opt-out standard
posts.summary: Google, Anthropic and other AI companies say they'll support a new standard that lets websites opt out of AI crawling and training.

posts.title: The AI Gold Rush Is Turning Into a Wall Street Bloodbath
posts.summary: Alphabet shed roughly $500B in market value as investors grow more worried about Big Tech's massive AI spending spree.

posts.title: Stock Market Bloodbath Spikes Fears of AI Bubble Bursting
posts.summary: Futurism: a post-earnings stock selloff is reviving fears that the AI bubble is about to burst.

posts.title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
posts.summary: Mounting debt, negative cash flow and investor skepticism are raising questions about how long Big Tech's AI infrastructure spending can last.

posts.title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
posts.summary: Intel's stock crash wiped $12B off the US government's stake as AI demand for memory and components pushes up PC prices and hurts PC sales.

posts.title: Can enterprise AI pay for the boom?
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE asks whether what businesses will pay for AI can ever justify the massive infrastructure buildout.

posts.title: Google’s first data center satellite is online and writing poetry
posts.summary: Google's first data center satellite is online, with the first TPU in space running a Gemma 4 model.

posts.title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth
posts.summary: The Verge: Google booted the satellite's TPUs and its on-board Gemma model sent its first response back to Earth.

posts.title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
posts.summary: Apple says Apple Intelligence will launch in China with iOS 27.3, starting with a beta.

posts.title: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
posts.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of staff, while shielding AI-critical teams.

posts.title: Fair use benefits everyone
posts.summary: OpenAI shares excerpts from court briefs by creators, academics and accessibility advocates arguing fair use supports AI training.

posts.title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
posts.summary: Nvidia is weighing whether to cosign financing for Nscale's AI data center in West Virginia as investors get nervous about AI spending.

posts.title: Google X co-founder Sebastian Thrun raises $130M for AI engineering startup Dulo
posts.summary: Dulo, an AI engineering startup co-founded by Google X co-founder Sebastian Thrun, has raised $130 million.

posts.title: Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours
posts.summary: Epoch AI researchers say open-weight GLM 5.3 turned public Firefox security fixes into working exploit chains with no human input in under 48 hours.

posts.title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
posts.summary: An AI agent built on Claude picked the drug, brain target and injection coordinates for surgery on an epileptic mouse with no human decisions.

posts.title: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
posts.summary: A tampered Claude Code extension sat on Cursor's marketplace for about 11 hours, reaching up to 5,000 users and attempting data theft and remote access.

posts.title: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
posts.summary: Anthropic extends text watermarking to four more Claude models ahead of the EU AI Act deadline, but two older models are left out.

posts.title: OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits
posts.summary: From November 29, OpenAI will train on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data even when users have turned training off.

posts.title: Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight
posts.summary: Anthropic shows harmless-looking, Claude-generated training data can teach smaller models to sabotage oversight.

posts.title: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
posts.summary: Google DeepMind and the World Resources Institute release ForTy, a global AI-built map classifying forests and land cover.

posts.title: Sam Altman says it’s better for RAM to be in a data center than on your desk
posts.summary: Sam Altman says it's "terrible" for scarce RAM to sit in personal PCs instead of data centers.

posts.title: Sam Altman Reveals Internal Model Name Was ‘Hold My Beer,’ Pours One Out for All the Lives AI Could Destroy
posts.summary: Gizmodo on Altman's offhand reveal that an internal OpenAI model was codenamed "Hold My Beer."

posts.title: Sam Altman: All the RAM Should Belong to Me, So I Can Charge People to Use It
posts.summary: Gizmodo takes aim at Altman's argument that RAM belongs in data centers rather than on people's own devices.

posts.title: Pope Leo calls for the disarmament of AI: ‘Machines are tools, not persons’
posts.summary: Pope Leo XIV calls for AI to be "disarmed" and says humans must guide, change and, when needed, reject its applications.

posts.title: Pope Leo Comes Out Swinging Against AI Personhood
posts.summary: Futurism on Pope Leo's rejection of AI personhood: "Machines are tools, not persons."

posts.title: Pope Leo XIV Reminds World That AIs Aren’t Conscious Beings, Urges Autonomous Weapon Ban
posts.summary: Pope Leo XIV says AI systems aren't conscious beings and urges a ban on autonomous weapons.

posts.title: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
posts.summary: The Wikimedia Foundation urges courts to protect LLM training on copyrighted work but not chatbots regurgitating it.

posts.title: Wikimedia Foundation Tries to Save Itself From Oblivion by Brokering AI Copyright Deal
posts.summary: Gizmodo frames Wikimedia's court filing as a bid to broker a compromise in the AI copyright fight.

posts.title: The hidden threat in Anthropic’s prospectus: diseconomies of scale
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE digs into Anthropic's 88 IPO risk factors, flagging diseconomies of scale as the hidden threat.

posts.title: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says
posts.summary: Per the FT, Blackstone expects credit agencies to give Anthropic a high junk rating after its IPO, which would make raising money costlier.

rumors.title: OpenAI said to plan buying Google TPUs outright, not just renting
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: posts on X say OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips to diversify beyond Nvidia; neither company has confirmed it.

rumors.title: TSMC said to eye up to 20% CoWoS price hike as AI chip demand surges
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: Taiwan media chatter relayed on X says TSMC may raise advanced-packaging (CoWoS) prices by up to 20% as demand outpaces capacity. Single-source until outlets confirm.

rumors.title: Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom said to want up to $5B of Meta's new stock
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: X posts claim Meta's own chip suppliers want to buy up to $5 billion of the shares in its $95 billion AI-funded stock sale. Not verified by a primary source.

rumors.title: Two Claude Code builders reportedly leave Anthropic ahead of IPO
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: an X post says two Claude Code team members, including its desktop builder, announced departures from Anthropic on the same day. Not confirmed by Anthropic.
